cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my pen down like you. Good, the argument's finished. Tea and one honest sentence each will fix last night's shouting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My pen ran out. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, no pens needed. I'll repeat each sentence back so you know I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather finish the whole thing first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, the whole thing, then one sentence from me. You tell me if I got it right before I say anything else.

reason: Replace stock certainty with a particular copied misunderstanding that shapes concealment, disclosure order, healthy-break framing, or improvised relationship repair; keep B consequential.
